profile.summary: A Florida-based company that makes software and offers consulting to help schools and colleges manage safety, security and behavioral health. Its EagleEyED platform helps school districts track site assessments, safety tasks and emergency drills, and its ThrivED platform supports threat assessment coaching. It also provides cybersecurity and security training services.

sources.title: 6 Major K-12 Districts to Pilot Data-Driven Safety Program

review.notes: GovTech names Oakland Unified among six pilot districts for Safer School Solutions' EagleEyED platform and says the company is headquartered in Florida, matching the agenda's Fort Lauderdale, FL. The NPPGov page supports the legal name and the summary's products and services, and saferschoolsolutions.com loads as the company's own site.
